data.navTitle: 保护区大门、地图与上坡小径
data.title: A gate before the hill

memoryNodes.cue: The short path passes the growing room.
The ground rises at the start.

data.situation:
On Saturday, Maya and Jo met a ranger called Ruth at the gate of a nature reserve. A narrow path led uphill from the visitor hut. Two longer trails crossed the rough terrain beyond it. Jo had imagined a remote place with no other visitors, but a family was already studying the map. Ruth suggested the shorter path first: it passed the glass growing room and ended beside a pond. Jo: Does the path go uphill all the way?
Ruth: Only at the start. Keep to the marked trails; the ground beside them is uneven.
Maya: Can we get to the pond without taking the long route?
Ruth: Yes. Turn left after the glass room.

Ruth suggested the shorter path first: it passed the glass growing room and ended beside a pond.
readingBlocks.zh: 星期六，玛雅和乔在自然保护区门口见到护林员露丝。一条窄径从游客小屋向上延伸，两条较长步道穿过后面的崎岖地形。乔原以为这里偏远得没有别的游客，但已有一家人在看地图。露丝建议先走短径：经过玻璃种植室，在池塘边结束。

readingBlocks.en:
Jo: Does the path go uphill all the way?
Ruth: Only at the start. Keep to the marked trails; the ground beside them is uneven.
Maya: Can we get to the pond without taking the long route?
Ruth: Yes. Turn left after the glass room.
readingBlocks.zh:
乔：这条路一直上坡吗？
露丝：只有起点上坡。沿标记步道走，旁边地面不平。
玛雅：不走长线也能到池塘吗？
露丝：可以，在玻璃房后左转。
